4-s70.condition: Unit 5, Lesson 28 City or Country?, упр. 4, с. 70. Прослушай Хелен ещё раз: что хорошего в городе?
steps: Есть хорошие стороны и у города: города веселее, там больше магазинов, кинотеатров и спортивных центров; проще добраться до школы.
4-s70.answer: Города веселее, больше магазинов и развлечений, удобнее транспорт

5-s71.condition: Unit 5, Lesson 28, упр. 5, с. 71. a) Прослушай вопросы и подумай над ответами. b) В парах: Which is quieter, a city or the country?
steps: a) It's quieter in the country. It's more beautiful in the country. It's cleaner in the country. There are more cars and buses in the city. It's more exciting in the city.
b) A: Which is quieter: a city or the country? B: The country, because there are more cars and buses in the city. A: Which is more exciting? B: The city, because there are more things to do.
5-s71.answer: Сравнение города и деревни: quieter, more beautiful, cleaner — country; more exciting, more shops — city

6-s71.condition: Unit 5, Lesson 28, упр. 6, с. 71. Напиши о месте, где живёшь: плюсы и минусы.
steps: I live in the country, in a small village called Morki. There are some good things and bad things about living here. It's quieter and cleaner than in the city. The air is fresh and the nature is beautiful. But it's more boring: there is no cinema and the shops are far away. I like my village anyway.
6-s71.answer: Текст 6–7 предложений с плюсами (quieter, cleaner) и минусами (more boring, no cinema)

culture-spot-s71.condition: Unit 5, Lesson 28, Culture spot, с. 71. Прочитай о чудесах природы и расскажи об одном.
steps: I know a natural wonder — the Great Barrier Reef. It's in the Coral Sea, not far from Australia. It's the world's biggest coral reef. It's more than 2 000 km long. You can see it from space. Many fish and turtles live there.
culture-spot-s71.answer: Рассказ о чуде природы: что, где, чем известно (например, Большой Барьерный риф)

steps: The Russian sturgeon weighs more than a hundred kilos — больше 100 кг.

2-s72.answer: Сивучи; осётр — самый большой; амурский тигр — самый редкий; нерпа — пресноводная

grammar-s75.condition: Unit 5, Language Guide, Grammar, с. 75. Степени сравнения прилагательных и объектные местоимения.
steps: Сравнительная: короткие + -er (taller), длинные — more (more beautiful); превосходная: the + -est / the most; исключения good — better — the best, bad — worse — the worst.
Объектные местоимения: me, you, him, her, it, us, them — отвечают на вопросы «кого? кому?» и стоят после глагола или предлога (Look at him).

He doesn't have to: get up early, do any chores, wear a school uniform.
11-s79.answer: has to — готовиться к школе, делать уроки, рано ложиться; doesn't have to — рано вставать, дела по дому, форма

12-s79.condition: Unit 6, Lesson 31, упр. 12, с. 79. Составь два вопроса из слов и ответь.
steps: Does your friend have to do any chores? — Yes, he does. / No, she doesn't.
Do you have to wear a tie? — Yes, I do. / No, I don't.

2-s87.condition: Unit 6, Lesson 36, упр. 2, с. 87. Какие британские правила такие же, как у нас?
steps: In our country the safety rules are the same: you mustn't run in the corridors, you must wear goggles in the science lab, you mustn't touch electric sockets, you must know the fire exit.

project-s87.condition: Unit 6, Lesson 36, Project, с. 87. Напиши правила безопасности для своей школы со знаками.
steps: You mustn't run in the classroom (зачёркнутый бегущий человечек). You mustn't play with fire. You must wash your hands before lunch. You mustn't open windows without a teacher. You must walk on the right in the corridors.

grammar-s88.condition: Unit 6, Language Guide, Grammar, с. 88. Модальные глаголы can, must, have to.
steps: can — умею / могу / разрешено: I can swim; You can't run here. Вопрос: Can you…?
must — обязан (правило): You must stop. mustn't — запрещено: You mustn't park here.
have to — приходится, вынужден: I have to get up early; he has to…; отрицание don't / doesn't have to — не обязательно; вопрос Do you have to…?
grammar-s88.answer: can / can't — возможность и разрешение; must / mustn't — правило и запрет; have to / don't have to — необходимость и её отсутствие

vocabulary-s88.condition: Unit 6, Language Guide, Vocabulary, с. 88. Новая лексика: одежда, кулинария, спорт, дорога.
steps: Clothes: jacket — пиджак, shirt — рубашка, skirt — юбка, slippers — тапочки, tie — галстук, trousers — брюки.
Cooking: bake — печь, bowl — миска, butter — масло, core — вынуть сердцевину, flour — мука, sugar — сахар.
Sport: head — бить головой, carry — нести, catch — ловить, throw — бросать, kick — пинать, hit — бить, roll — катить, hold — держать.
Traffic: crash helmet — шлем, crossroads — перекрёсток, cycle lane — велодорожка, pavement — тротуар, pedestrian crossing — переход, traffic lights — светофор.

steps: a) Do you have to; Can you; Do you have to; Can you.
b) Yes, we have to. Yes, I can. No, we don't have to. No, we can't.
1-s90.answer: a) Do you have to / Can you / Do you have to / Can you; b) Yes, we have to / Yes, I can / No, we don't / No, we can't

steps: are … doing; am watching; Are … watching?; Are … doing?; am reading; Is … doing?; is playing; Is … playing?
1-s91.answer: are doing, am watching, are you watching, are you doing, am reading, is he doing, is playing, is she playing

2-s91.condition: Units 4–6 Revision, упр. 2, с. 91. Напиши 4 предложения с наречиями always / often / usually / never.
steps: I never walk to school. I often hang out with my friends after school. I sometimes surf the internet. I usually get up at seven.

3-s91.condition: Units 4–6 Revision, упр. 3, с. 91. Составь предложения о себе и друзьях в сравнительной степени.
steps: I'm older than her. He's better at sport than me. She's more talkative than him. She's funnier than me. I'm more friendly than him.
3-s91.answer: 5 сравнений с than и объектными местоимениями

4-s91.condition: Units 4–6 Revision, упр. 4, с. 91. Расставь слова в правильном порядке (вопросы).
steps: Is your chair more comfortable than mine? Is my bag bigger than your bag? Are you taller than me? Are you younger than me?
4-s91.answer: Is / Are + подлежащее + сравнительная степень + than …?

5-s91.condition: Units 4–6 Revision, упр. 5, с. 91. Заполни пропуски объектными местоимениями.
steps: me; her; him; us; it; them.
5-s91.answer: me, her, him, us, it, them

6-s92.condition: Units 4–6 Revision, упр. 6, с. 92. Выбери правильное слово.
steps: raining; play; go; am going.

7-s92.condition: Units 4–6 Revision, упр. 7, с. 92. Заполни пропуски превосходной степенью.
steps: oldest; youngest, most beautiful; friendliest, most talkative; most generous; fittest, best.
7-s92.answer: the oldest; the youngest, the most beautiful; the friendliest, the most talkative; the most generous; the fittest, the best

8-s92.condition: Units 4–6 Revision, упр. 8, с. 92. Напиши по два правила к каждому виду спорта с can / can't / have to.
steps: Basketball: You can pass the ball to other players. You can't kick the ball.
Bowling: You have to knock down the pins. You can't throw two balls at once.
Football: You can kick and head the ball. You can't carry the ball (except the goalkeeper).

9-s92.condition: Units 4–6 Revision, упр. 9, с. 92. Найди в змейке 5 слов, связанных с дорогой.
steps: parking meter, traffic lights, pavement, pedestrian crossing, traffic warden.

10-s92.condition: Units 4–6 Revision, упр. 10, с. 92. Соедини слова со знаками и назови правила.
steps: You must keep straight on. You mustn't park here. You mustn't turn left. You must stop. You must wear a crash helmet. You mustn't cycle here.
10-s92.answer: 6 правил с must / mustn't по знакам

quiz-s93.condition: Unit 7 Life in the Past, с. 93. 1) Угадай профессии по картинкам. 2) Соотнеси знаменитостей с профессиями.
steps: 1) a) an athlete, b) a dancer, c) a scientist, d) a writer, e) a painter.

1-s94.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 37 Famous People, упр. 1, с. 94. Прослушай и соотнеси людей с профессиями.
steps: Anna Pavlova — dancer; Leonardo da Vinci — artist, inventor, scientist; Marie and Pierre Curie — scientists; Charles Dickens — writer.
1-s94.answer: dancer; artist, inventor, scientist; scientists; writer

2-s94.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 37, упр. 2, с. 94. Прослушай и прочитай факты о знаменитостях.
steps: Anna Pavlova was a famous Russian dancer. Leonardo da Vinci was an Italian artist, inventor and scientist. Marie and Pierre Curie were scientists — she was Polish, he was French. Charles Dickens was an English writer.

steps: Anna Pavlova — dancer — Russian. Leonardo da Vinci — artist, inventor, scientist — Italian. Marie Curie — scientist — Polish. Pierre Curie — scientist — French. Charles Dickens — writer — English.

4-s95.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 37, упр. 4, с. 95. Расскажи об одном из людей из текста.
steps: Marie Curie was a scientist. She was Polish. She was born in Poland in 1867. She and her husband Pierre discovered radium. She was the first woman to win a Nobel Prize.
4-s95.answer: 4–5 предложений с was / were о знаменитости

5-s95.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 37, упр. 5, с. 95. В парах задайте вопросы Who was…? о людях 1–4.
steps: A: Who was Isaac Levitan? B: He was a painter. A: Who was Mikhail Lomonosov? B: He was a poet and a scientist. A: Who was Yuri Gagarin? B: He was a cosmonaut. A: Who was Pyotr Tchaikovsky? B: He was a composer.
5-s95.answer: Who was …? — He was a painter / scientist / cosmonaut / composer

6-s95.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 37, упр. 6, с. 95. a) Прослушай новые слова и соотнеси с людьми. b) Проверь. c) Расскажи об одном.
steps: a–b) queen; athlete; teacher; singer; astronomer.
c) Jesse Owens was an athlete. He was American. He was born in 1913. He won four gold medals at the 1936 Olympic Games in Berlin.
6-s95.answer: queen, athlete, teacher, singer, astronomer; рассказ о Джесси Оуэнсе

7-s95.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 37, упр. 7, с. 95. a) Прослушай игру «Угадай, кто»: какие вопросы задают? b) Дополни предложения.
steps: a) Was he a singer? — No. Was he a painter? — Yes. Was he French? — No. Was he Spanish? — Yes. (Picasso)
b) an artist; Spanish. film stars; American.
7-s95.answer: Вопросы Was he …? и ответы; an artist, Spanish; film stars, American

8-s95.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 37, упр. 8, с. 95. a) Загадай знаменитость. b) В парах угадайте с помощью вопросов Was he / she…?
steps: a) Louisa May Alcott, writer, American.
b) A: Is it a woman or a man? B: A woman. A: Was she a singer? B: No, she wasn't. A: Was she a writer? B: Yes, she was. A: Was she American? B: Yes. A: Louisa May Alcott? B: Right!
8-s95.answer: Игра с вопросами Was she …? — Yes, she was / No, she wasn't

9-s95.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 37, упр. 9, с. 95. Найди информацию об известном человеке и напиши о нём.
steps: Jesse Owens was a track and field athlete. He was American. He was born in Alabama in 1913. He won four gold medals at the 1936 Olympics. He was one of the greatest athletes of the 20th century.
9-s95.answer: 5 предложений: кто, национальность, когда родился, чем знаменит

10-s95.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 37, упр. 10, с. 95. Дополни диалог формами was / wasn't / were / weren't.
steps: A: were. B: were. A: Were. B: was, was. A: Was. B: wasn't, was.
10-s95.answer: were, were, Were, was/was, Was, wasn't/was

11-s95.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 37, упр. 11, с. 95. Назови даты 1–4.
steps: 1812 — eighteen twelve; 2047 — twenty forty-seven; 1906 — nineteen oh six; 1900 — nineteen hundred.
11-s95.answer: eighteen twelve, twenty forty-seven, nineteen oh six, nineteen hundred

tip-s95.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 37, Tip, с. 95. Правило произношения дат.
steps: Четырёхзначный год делим на две пары: 1812 — eighteen twelve. Ноль в середине — oh: 1906 — nineteen oh six. Круглые сотни — hundred: 1900 — nineteen hundred. 2000 — two thousand; 2010 — twenty ten или two thousand and ten.
tip-s95.answer: Год читается двумя парами чисел; oh для нуля, hundred для круглых

1-s96.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 38 Nineteen Hundred, упр. 1, с. 96. Прослушай и потренируй произношение окончания -ed.
steps: played [pleɪd], used [juːzd], listened [ˈlɪsənd], travelled [ˈtrævəld] — [d]; cycled [ˈsaɪkəld]; watched [wɒtʃt], skied [skiːd]; wanted [ˈwɒntɪd], visited — [ɪd].
1-s96.answer: [d] после звонких, [t] после глухих, [ɪd] после t / d

2-s96.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 38, упр. 2, с. 96. По картинкам и записи скажи, что люди делали в 1900 году.
steps: Did people play football in 1900? — Yes, they did. Did they use computers? — No, they didn't. Did they travel by plane? — No, they didn't. Did they ski? — Yes, they did. Did they cycle? — Yes, they did. Did they watch TV? — No, they didn't.
2-s96.answer: Yes, they did: football, ski, cycle; No, they didn't: computers, planes, TV

3-s96.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 38, упр. 3, с. 96. Прослушай и потренируй вопросы Did they … in 1900?
steps: Did they play football in 1900? — Yes, they did. Did they use computers in 1900? — No, they didn't. Did they listen to the radio? — No, they didn't. Did they travel by train? — Yes, they did.
3-s96.answer: Did they + V … in 1900? — Yes, they did / No, they didn't

4-s97.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 38, упр. 4, с. 97. a) Выбери правильный вариант о жизни в 1900. b) Проверь по записи.
steps: played; didn't use; didn't travel; skied; cycled; didn't watch.
4-s97.answer: played, didn't use, didn't travel, skied, cycled, didn't watch

5-s97.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 38, упр. 5, с. 97. Составь вопросы по таблице и ответь.
steps: Did you play football yesterday? — Yes, I did. Did your friend use a computer? — Yes, he did. Did your parents travel last summer? — No, they didn't. Did you watch TV last night? — Yes, I did.
5-s97.answer: Did + подлежащее + V? — Yes, … did / No, … didn't

6-s97.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 38, упр. 6, с. 97. a) Составь 3 вопроса о жизни в прошлом. b) Задай их учителю.
steps: Did pupils use computers at school? Did people play football? Did people travel abroad?
Учитель отвечает: No, they didn't. Yes, they did. Not often.
6-s97.answer: 3 вопроса в Past Simple с Did …?

7-s97.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 38, упр. 7, с. 97. a) Ответь на вопросы о прошлых выходных. b) В парах. c) Расскажи об однокласснике.
steps: a) Did you phone your friends? — Yes, I did. Did you listen to music? — Yes, I did. Did you play computer games? — No, I didn't. Did you visit your grandparents? — Yes, I did.
c) Misha phoned his friends. He listened to music. He didn't play computer games. He visited his grandparents.
7-s97.answer: Ответы Yes, I did / No, I didn't и рассказ: Misha phoned / didn't phone…

8-s97.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 38, упр. 8, с. 97. Напиши, что делали твои родители в твоём возрасте.
steps: When my parents were my age, they went to school. They didn't use computers and mobile phones. They cycled and played football in the yard. They listened to music on cassettes. They watched TV, but they didn't watch videos on the internet.

9-s97.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 38, упр. 9, с. 97. Составь 6 предложений о прошлых выходных.
steps: I listened to music last weekend. I watched TV. I played football with my friends. I visited my grandmother. I didn't use the computer. I didn't travel anywhere.
9-s97.answer: 6 предложений в Past Simple о выходных
